description: This file defines the Debug class within the Opencart Admin Controller Event namespace. It extends a system Controller and includes methods for handling pre- and post-execution logic for routes, specifically for debugging purposes. The class provides hooks like before() and after() to insert custom debug logic during the event lifecycle in OpenCart's admin interface.
